summary: Autohome Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a new $400 million share repurchase program authorized by its board, effective July 28, 2026, for up to 12 months. The company may repurchase ADSs through open market, privately negotiated, or block trade transactions, funded from existing cash. No fixed price, premium, or advisor named. This is an issuer capital-return program, not a tender offer. Watch the pace of buybacks relative to market conditions and potential program expansions or suspensions.
